findings.message: Unsupported container setup: Every Dockerfile with a start command copies files the repository does not contain (docker/deployment.Dockerfile copies typesense-server). Deployz builds the app from a Dockerfile in the repository.

The Dockerfile copies typesense-server, which the repository does not contain (a build step makes it before docker build). Deployz builds from the repository only. Add a Dockerfile that builds the app from source, or select another Dockerfile.
